summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing a notification under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation regarding transactions in Cadeler shares by a person discharging managerial responsibilities or a closely associated person. Specifically, BW Altor Pte. Ltd., closely associated with Chair Andreas Sohmen-Pao, conducted share transactions on the listed dates. Details of the transactions are in an attached notification. This is a routine insider-dealing disclosure for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US Form 4 filing, and does not represent a special-situation event.
